review.description: S1–S4 move the saved-state projection to session chat/status and normalized event inspection with separate execution/report/pending values. Retained output is paged and matching completed messages replace their streamed deltas. C6 clarifies independent execution/reported status: another pending explicit status question keeps reported blocked, and native blockers independently retain waiting. Owning subscriptions update when blocked and answered. Current incremental review: Saved-work inspection and execution/status separation are unchanged; query navigation reuses derived rows without claiming measured latency.
review.implementation: Read NewFactory state/transcript APIs, wrapper transcriptMessages and factory output redaction. UI bridge alone contacts MCP; owner credentials never enter the iframe. The production deferred shell retains seven actionable navigation labels before runtime/provider work. Read requests.go transactional session.changed for blocked and answered transitions plus reportedBlocked scan; retained-refresh freshness guard prevents status/source context rollback. Current incremental review: Read factoryInboxCache serialization and version key, factoryState preprojection cursor capture and selectedEntry value copies. Questions and session summaries remain freshly projected.
review.tests: Read WRAP-STATUS, WRAP-ASSEMBLED, split-secret redaction, stream-completion regression and the isolated production launch performance test. Browser fixture tests validate exact rendered values and native answer continuation. The 100 ms gate covers fixture launch samples only; real-host soak remains open. S1/S2 view-specific projection returns a bounded bodyless page, compact pending counts and explicit delivery state; settings/proposals are configuration-only and historical questions are metadata-only/bounded. S3 browser checks matched stream/completion once. No fixture is described as production native-host acceptance. Cycle2 S3 fixture drains12available100-event pages without one-second delays, retains1000rows, and reconstructs page-spanning Unicode/quote/control JSON fragments only after complete ordered sets; incomplete tails render nothing. Distinct completed IDs a/b both remain visible while matching stream/completion deduplicates. Cycle2 native completion regression drops unrendered non-agent output, fragments a large agent completion while preserving exact message ID/text, and store regression proves valid UTF8 rows<=32KiB with bounded100-row pages and exact JSON reconstruction. Browser separately proves across-page reconstruction and incomplete-tail omission. Cycle3 browser assertions prove idle sinceVersion reuse, saved-state refresh on change, cursor reset per exact query generation and stale full response rejection. Transcript output remains independent; no idle state response invents completion. Cycle3 transport sentinel proves unchanged cursor returns before complete projection decoding; metadata mutations advance the durable cursor, output does not. Native stream test uses20queued100KiBcontexts and50deltas, checks full session bytes unchanged, compact runtime<=512bytes with exact pendingCount20 and no pending payload, successful delta despite opaque nondecodable pending, and stale-epoch rejection. Atomic store identity follows Put/CAS/delete/rollback. These are concrete work-bound assertions, not measured latency claims. Cycle4 stale-state regression removes the100ms sleep and eventual-last-request check. It captures request count before releasing the held old poll and awaits its first successor, which is scheduled only after that poll consumes the response. That exact successor must carry version3, so a rewind to2 fails even if its reply later restores current rows. All33mocked browser cases and TypeScript passed; registry wording now names that consumption barrier precisely. Cycle5 runtime projection bound is now512bytes with exactpendingCount20 and no pending payload, still preserving50streamdeltas, canonical queues and stale epoch rejection. Scheduler guards avoid decoding15held/14due-paused/1running poisoned queue histories and preserve deferred busy configuration over3ticks; these establish concrete work avoidance, not measured latency. Read exact session.changed subscriber integration: two notifications with no question/answer text; blocking and nonblocking native requests plus two explicit blockers retain blocked/waiting until final answer. Read concurrent provider barrier assertions for current saved/batch context only. Current incremental review: Read STATE-QUERY-CACHE and existing STATE-UNCHANGED: query changes avoid repeated full inbox decoding, live source mutation refreshes, and transcript-only events remain independent.
